answer: Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Because the rationale is hashed into the oasis record and indexed in the vine history, the ocean audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 58 aliases thus needs 58 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
